bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Suspended captain Mendieta leaves Karditsa blunt against Kallithea's tight defense.

spf.comment: Covers both the leading 0:1 Kallithea breakthrough and a 0:0 stalemate, as the visitors' modest road scoring keeps a single call riskier.

over_under.comment: A 1.83 combined lambda, 72.3% Poisson baseline, and six of Kallithea's last seven league games ending under 2.5 point to tight scoring.

btts.comment: Kallithea concede just 0.64 goals per match while Karditsa lose joint top scorer Mendieta from a 0.73 goals-per-game attack.

score.comment: The top two baseline Poisson scores reflect Kallithea's clean-sheet edge either breaking through late or being held to a goalless draw.

goals.comment: One-goal and two-goal outcomes capture over 56% of the baseline distribution in a fixture shaped by defensive structure.

bqc.comment: Both scripts project a level first half before Kallithea either find a second-half winner or Karditsa's low block holds out.
